text.tspan: Handbook section 2.4 (seeing): look 12 to 15 seconds ahead. At lower speeds that is about one block; at highway speeds about
a quarter-mile. Also use your mirrors and scan side to side -- looking far ahead is not a substitute for a mirror check or a
blind-spot check before you move over.
